public.title: Reorder List
public.description: The array encodes a singly linked list in head-to-tail order. Return values reordered first,last,second,second-last and so on, using each node once. This value-only adaptation does not check node identity or mutation. Length is 0 to 1000; integers are between -1000 and 1000.
hints: Read alternately from both ends of the array representation.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Two indices emit the remaining outer pair until they meet. O(n) time and output space.
